item.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
item.description: The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.
item.content:encoded:
The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.

(Image credit: Andrew Harnik)

item.title: House Republicans to elect a new leader as they look to rebuild from midterm defeat
item.description: After sweeping losses in the midterm elections, the House GOP will vote on Tuesday to elect a successor to Mike Johnson, who says he's stepping down as the chamber's top Republican.

item.title: The Democratic Party gained power across the country in the midterms. Now what?
item.description: Voters handed Democrats the keys to power across the country and expect them to drive in a different direction. Party leaders are now trying to figure out which way to go.

item.title: Trump's crypto profits raise alarms for transparency advocates
item.description: President Trump has made nearly $3 billion while in office, most of it in crypto ventures. And to the alarm of transparency advocates, much of the president's money comes from foreign sources.

item.title: California voters defeat billionaire tax proposal that divided Democrats
item.description: The novel proposal would have charged billionaires a one-time 5% tax on most of their overall wealth, including their ownership in companies.

item.title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
item.description: France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.
